blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Preparations are underway across the Philippines for Undas 2026, as authorities gear up for the influx of cemetery visitors and travelers heading to their home provinces to observe All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day.
A mass exodus began as early as Thursday, October 29, as Filipinos took advantage of the long weekend to visit their departed loved ones.
Follow our live updates for the latest on cemetery preparations, traffic conditions, passenger volume, public transport, weather advisories, and safety measures as the country observes Undas./dp
